plan.title: install: two-pass fixture allowlist drifted from owned-paths (data-schema.json, seed placeholder)

narratives.Description: The post-publish two-pass fixture (#4271) fails because installerManagedMatchers() does not list .deft/directive/data-schema.json or the xbrief seed marker that install writes. This story adds both as exact matchers in packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts, with a hygiene test.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

The post-publish two-pass fixture (#4271) failed on v0.131.0 (run 44976831079) and v0.130.1 (run 44678506561): `Pass 2 commit-set includes non-installer-managed paths: .deft/directive/data-schema.json, xbrief/.directive-seed-placeholder`. `installerManagedMatchers()` in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts` lists neither path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `installerManagedMatchers()` lists `.deft/directive/data-schema.json` and `xbrief/.directive-seed-placeholder` as exact paths, and `isPass2CommitPath` accepts both.
- [ ] A hygiene test covers both paths and a nearby non-owned path that stays rejected.

Refs #4271, #6842, #6860, #5771, #6969.
narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want the post-publish two-pass fixture to accept the two paths install writes, so that a release cut does not fail on allowlist drift.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add two exact matchers to installerManagedMatchers() in packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts. Add one hygiene.test.ts case for both paths and a non-owned neighbour. Add one changelog fragment. Do not change what install writes, and do not rewire the classifier to owned-paths.ts (#6969).

issueCommentThread.body:
Narrowed 2026-11-21 (operator decision): this issue now covers only the two exact allowlist entries plus a hygiene test.

- The two install decisions (seed placeholder written when PROJECT-DEFINITION exists; Pass 2 classifier reading `owned-paths.ts`) moved to #6969 for the install/setup owner.
- The post-publish two-pass fixture proof comes from the next release cut, not from this PR.
design-critique: not warranted, because it is a two-line allowlist addition with a test.

expected_outputs: hygiene.test.ts case: both paths pass isPass2CommitPath; a non-owned neighbour does not
